data.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Panama City
data.address: Edificio Pacific Center, C. Ramon H. Jurado, Panama City, Panamá Province, Panama
data.description:
Set amid shopping malls in a commercial area, this informal all-suite hotel is 5 km from 18th-century architecture and nightlife in the charming Casco Viejo neighborhood. It's a 5-minute walk from Paitilla Park on the Pacific Ocean and 19 km from Tocumen International Airport.
Relaxed studios provide flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, plus kitchenettes. The 1-bedroom suites add separate living rooms. Some quarters have ocean views.
Amenities include a colorful lobby lounge/bar with floor-to-ceiling windows, plus a gym. There's also a rooftop pool featuring a sundeck and skyline views. Breakfast, Wi-Fi and parking are offered.
